# World Monitor Blog

> Analysis, practical guides, and methodology for real-time global intelligence, OSINT, geopolitics, markets, supply chains, and AI agents.

Canonical blog index: https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/
RSS feed: https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/rss.xml
Author: https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/authors/elie-habib/

## Comparisons and buying guides

- [All buying guides](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/guides/)
- [ACLED alternatives for intelligence teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/alternatives/acled/): ACLED alternatives ranked by why teams leave: access limits, live monitoring, alerts and API. Compare World Monitor, Liveuamap and Recorded Future.
- [Crisis24 alternatives for intelligence teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/alternatives/crisis24/): Crisis24 alternatives ranked by why teams leave: cost, self-serve access, alert routing and API. Compare World Monitor, Factal, Dataminr and Recorded Future.
- [Dataminr alternatives for intelligence teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/alternatives/dataminr/): Dataminr alternatives for breaking alerts, ranked by cost, self-serve access, verification and API: World Monitor, Factal, Liveuamap and Recorded Future.
- [Factal alternatives for intelligence teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/alternatives/factal/): Factal alternatives for incident alerts, ranked by published pricing, self-serve rules, alert routing and API. Compare World Monitor, Dataminr and Liveuamap.
- [Liveuamap alternatives for intelligence teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/alternatives/liveuamap/): Liveuamap alternatives ranked by wider coverage, alert rules, API access and structured data. Compare World Monitor, ACLED, Factal and Dataminr.
- [Recorded Future alternatives for intelligence teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/alternatives/recorded-future/): Recorded Future alternatives ranked by cost, self-serve access, alerts and API. Compare World Monitor, Dataminr, Factal and Crisis24 for geopolitical risk.
- [Best conflict data platforms for researchers](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/conflict-data-platforms-for-researchers/): Compare conflict data platforms for researchers: ACLED for coded event datasets, World Monitor for live cross-domain context and API, and Liveuamap for cases.
- [Best conflict monitoring tools for humanitarian teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/conflict-monitoring-tools-for-humanitarian-teams/): Compare conflict monitoring tools for NGOs: ACLED for trend data, Crisis24 for staff assistance, World Monitor (free map, Pro country alerts), and Factal.
- [Best geopolitical monitoring tools for energy analysts](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/geopolitical-monitoring-tools-for-energy-analysts/): Compare geopolitical tools for energy analysts: World Monitor for live Hormuz and Red Sea chokepoint traffic, Dataminr for site alerts, and Recorded Future.
- [Best geopolitical monitoring tools for journalists](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/geopolitical-monitoring-tools-for-journalists/): Compare geopolitical monitoring tools for journalists: Liveuamap for one conflict, World Monitor for tiered source labels, ACLED for trends, and Factal.
- [Best geopolitical risk tools for supply chain teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/geopolitical-risk-tools-for-supply-chain-teams/): Compare geopolitical risk tools for supply chain teams: World Monitor for live chokepoint traffic and route alerts, Dataminr for sites, and Recorded Future.
- [Best global intelligence dashboards for macro analysts](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/global-intelligence-dashboards-for-macro-analysts/): Compare global intelligence dashboards for macro analysts: World Monitor for live events, chokepoints and markets, ACLED for conflict data, Recorded Future.
- [Best intelligence APIs for developers](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/intelligence-apis-for-developers/): Compare geopolitical intelligence APIs for developers and AI agents: World Monitor for self-serve REST, SDKs and MCP, Recorded Future, and ACLED event data.
- [Best OSINT dashboards for students](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/osint-dashboards-for-students/): Compare OSINT dashboards for students: World Monitor for a free, open-source global map with tiered source labels, ACLED for conflict coding, and Liveuamap.
- [Best risk intelligence platforms for corporate security teams](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/risk-intelligence-platforms-for-corporate-security-teams/): Compare risk intelligence platforms for corporate security teams: Dataminr for GSOCs, World Monitor for self-serve alerts, Recorded Future and Crisis24.
- [Best travel risk tools for travel managers](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/best/travel-risk-tools-for-travel-managers/): Compare travel risk tools for travel managers: Crisis24 for duty-of-care assistance, Dataminr for enterprise alerts, and World Monitor for country alerts.
- [World Monitor vs ACLED](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/vs/acled/): World Monitor vs ACLED for conflict tracking: ACLED provides coded research datasets, while World Monitor adds a live map, country alerts, REST API and MCP.
- [World Monitor vs Crisis24](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/vs/crisis24/): World Monitor vs Crisis24 for travel and security risk: Crisis24 covers traveler assistance, while World Monitor offers self-serve country alerts and an API.
- [World Monitor vs Dataminr](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/vs/dataminr/): World Monitor vs Dataminr for breaking event alerts: Dataminr offers enterprise SLA detection, while World Monitor provides self-serve alert rules and API.
- [World Monitor vs Factal](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/vs/factal/): World Monitor vs Factal for incident alerts: Factal has 24/7 journalist verification, while World Monitor offers self-serve alert rules, webhooks, API and MCP.
- [World Monitor vs Liveuamap](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/vs/liveuamap/): World Monitor vs Liveuamap for conflict maps: Liveuamap offers low-cost regional conflict feeds, while World Monitor adds shipping, flights, alerts and API.
- [World Monitor vs Recorded Future](https://www.worldmonitor.app/blog/vs/recorded-future/): World Monitor vs Recorded Future for risk intelligence: Recorded Future covers enterprise cyber investigations, while World Monitor offers self-serve alerts.
